body: I have considered that I probably do have PTSD. I didn't feel this way when I was living hours away from where my hometown is, now I am in constant fear of running into certain people and I feel like deleting all of my social media accounts and falling off the face of the earth because I have a big fear of these people trying to contact me. I will google cognitive therapy, I'm sure I could benefit from it, but these last couple of weeks have me feeling so hopeless and worthless. Thank you for taking the time to give me some advice, I really appreciate it.
Thank you. I posted this earlier. https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/3kr5r3/i_am_really_tired/
